title: Reducing Racial Disparities in Consumer Credit: Evidence from Anonymous Loan Applications
eligible_reason: Single platform-wide change: names removed from applications on 28 Sept 2021 (build_sample.do lines 151-155: before_change/after_change by application_date). Treatment contrast is minority vs majority applicants (min_showing = minority x before, min_noshowing = minority x after), all switched at one date. Application-level repeated cross-section, not a staggered adoption design.
design_notes: Stata/R. Application-lender pair and application-level data from a Singapore online loan comparison platform. Tables 2-5: reghdfe outcome min_showing min_noshowing, absorb(application_month i.before_change#i.ml_code + categorical applicant controls), cluster ml_code or application_month. Figure 1 is a monthly minority-by-month dynamic plot around Sept 2021. Table 6: post-change offer choice. Table 7: loan performance.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One change date (28 Sept 2021) applies to every application and lender.

specs.exclusion_reason: common date (28 Sept 2021); treatment contrast is applicant minority status, repeated cross-section of applications; categorical applicant controls

data_files_note: README.pdf: confidential platform data excluded; data_raw/data_derived folders not shipped; replication on site at NUS on request. Only code, logs and result PNGs are included.
data_provenance_note: Confidential platform data; no data in package.
screener_notes: Common-date anonymization experiment; not staggered. Data not shipped.
